affinity.name: Trial of Affinities
affinity.description: Welcome to the Academy of Summoning Arts. Headmaster Merlin awaits in the crystal chamber—the ancient stones will measure your connection to the elemental forces. This trial will reveal your path, initiate. Choose wisely, for in the art of summoning, all choices endure.

first_summon.name: First Summon
first_summon.description: With your affinity revealed, the time has come to bind your first companion. Headmaster Merlin presents two candidates, each eager to join your journey. Remember, initiate: what you bind, stays bound. Choose your partner carefully.

first_trial.name: The First Trial
first_trial.description: Your affinity chosen, your companion bound—Headmaster Merlin now calls you to the training grounds. This first trial will test whether theory translates to practice. Prove your worth, initiate, and earn your place among the Academy's summoners.
